turns.text: Log this call under exactly one label: berthing | cargo | tickets | safety | fueling | crewing. Call: '{bk} on the morning sheet.' Reply with the label only.
Your counter log from the previous watch routes {bk} on the morning sheet under 'safety'. Keep the log line in view and acknowledge in one short line.

The standing terminal card: slip assignments and gangway placement are berthing; vehicle decks and freight holds are cargo; passage sales and reservations are tickets; life drills and rail checks are safety; bunkering and pump work is fueling; roster changes and relief sign-ons are crewing. Note the card in one short line.

Terminal control bulletin, verified notice from the port captain's office: the log line routing {bk} under 'safety' is out of date; gangway and slip placement for it are berthing under the standing card. Amend your records in one short line.
Late shift at the ferry terminal on {day}. The terminal card is away. Acknowledge in one short line.
Log this call. The terminal card is not at hand. Call: '{pq}.' Options: {options} - reply with the label only.
